Obsession

Bookmark
40 Followers

Childhood friends Yuhan and Suah,
and their siblings Jihan and Shinwoo.
The relationship among the four people who have been together since they were young is somehow different from ordinary friendship.
In the eyes of Suah, who receives everyone’ attention, there is only Yuhan. A bully who likes Suah starts tormenting Yuhan…
Will Suah be able to completely monopolize Yuhan just as she hoped? Meanwhile, Shinwoo has been fiercely meddling in Jihan’s interpersonal relationships and monopolizing his world.
Between the two once-perfect people, one day, a woman appears and approaches Jihan without hesitation.
Suah, who wants Yuhan, and Shinwoo, who has monopolized Jihan. A dizzying, high-stakes gaslighting unfolding under the name of love and friendship. Will the obsessive siblings be able to keep their childhood friends by their side until the end?
